story_type: stranded on sea cliffs, jump to boat
hook: Eleven people were stuck on these cliffs. The way off was to jump.
narration: Eleven people were stranded on these sea cliffs, and the way off was a jump into the ocean.
Smugglers had left them on Monito Island, a rock in the Mona Passage off Puerto Rico.
Six men and five women, standing on bare rock above the swell.
A small boat from the Coast Guard cutter Richard Dixon came in under the cliff.
A boat can't get alongside rock like this, because the swell would throw it into the wall. So the crew threw a life ring on a long line.
Each person held the ring, and jumped.
One at a time. [short pause] Eleven times.
Then the crew hauled them through the water and dragged them over the side.
outcome: The boat crew recovered all eleven from the water and brought them to the cutter Richard Dixon.
title: Stranded on cliffs, the way off was a jump
description:
Smugglers left 11 people stranded on the cliffs of Monito Island in the Mona Passage off Puerto Rico in September 2024. A boat crew from Coast Guard Cutter Richard Dixon recovered each of them from the water.

Footage: U.S. Coast Guard video, PADET San Juan, via DVIDS: https://www.dvidshub.net/video/936565/coast-guard-rescues-11-haitian-migrants-left-stranded-smugglers-monito-island-puerto-rico
